purpose: Make a complete, playable tabletop adventure book from a creator's brief through a fixed chain of 35 skills and a master (pack/).

model.notes: writing stages on the main model; audits should run on a separately configured model (same-model audits get a visible warning)

cost_flags: model calls for every writing and audit stage
optional paid image generation for book art
owner_approval: any gameplay mechanic or required story structure outside the approved scope
publication of the exact reviewed version
evaluation: Every stage output is checked against its output.schema.json by the application; audits and Book Fixer block release on defects; Final QA rescans all public copy and generated files.

provenance.source: built here (the owner's own skill pack); application code not included in this repo
provenance.license: unspecified (the repo owner picks one before publishing)

portability: Plain markdown skills with JSON contracts; any model that follows instructions can fill the ai stages.
